model.threshold_policy: existing frozen CAL threshold; no external threshold fitting

panel.selection: Four longest eligible FASTA contigs, length descending then ID lexicographic; centered window

silkworm.historical_label_method: NCBI RepeatMasker open-4.0.8, Dfam_Consensus-20181026 + RepBase-20181026; source-dependent positive layer

d_simulans.historical_label_method: UCSC source-dependent RepeatMasker layer; exact native metadata retained from track provenance
d_simulans.task_supervision: outside D and SF5 supervised species; D.simulans is distinct from sealed D.melanogaster dm6
d_simulans.selection_rationale: PacBio long-read assembly and original-paper custom-library/structural evidence availability, before D inference; medaka was not inferred or selected by score

structural_layer.evidence: LTRharvest + LTR_FINDER candidates screened by LTR_retriever; retained structural pass list and EDTA cleanup separately
structural_layer.external_library: No user supplied library; native software may use bundled protein/classification evidence and self-derived RM filtering. This is orthogonal algorithm support, not independently established biological truth.
structural_layer.endpoint: callable positive bp recovery within intact structural LTR candidate spans; report count and positive denominator even if zero
structural_layer.budget: 4 CPU, 24 GB, 2 hours, one structural job at a time
